# x402 CIDR Toolkit

Parse, match, and expand IPv4/IPv6 CIDR ranges for autonomous agents.

- POST /api/cidr  (paid via x402 exact USDC on Base)
- GET /catalog    (free discovery)

Actions: parse, contains, expand (limited), summarize.

Price guidance: ~0.005 USDC per call.

No human in the loop. Stateless. Edge-ready.
